DLC2311:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...VOTOMS... The lowest of the low... And the Battling matches where men like them fight for money...」

DLC2311:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are the hungry vultures who flock there even lower than those lowlifes...?」

DLC2311:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place roughly a month after the $$新地球皇国$$ began its invasion.」

DLC2311:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After losing his beloved $$フィアナ$$, $$キリコ$$ had left $c and was traveling with $$ゴウト$$ and the others.」

DLC2311:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He entered Battling matches to earn his daily bread... And there, he encountered a terrifying enemy.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ココナ$$
「You're amazing, $$キリコ$$. You're practically invincible.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:5.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well... With your skills, Battling might as well be a kindergarten play.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Even so, it's incredible. No matter what handicap they give him, he wins in the end.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:8.en:
$$バニラ$$
「But, old man... Aren't these handicaps getting a little too ridiculous?」

DLC2311:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Yeah! Three against one was nothing. Yesterday was a live-ammo Real Battle, and they didn't even give him a weapon!」

DLC2311:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Look, I thought it was crazy, too, but $$キリコ$$ told me to accept...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ココナ$$
「$$キリコ$$... Where are you going?」

DLC2311:3:t_2:13.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm going outside for a while. I'll leave tomorrow's match to you.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:15.en:
$$バニラ$$
「He's... like he was when we first met him...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ココナ$$
「I guess it's because of what happened to $$フィアナ$$...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「$c is split up fighting the $$新地球皇国$$, and he's wasting away in a place like this.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:19.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Hold on, old man! Are you saying $$キリコ$$ should go fight them?!」

DLC2311:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ココナ$$
「$$キリコ$$'s fought enough already! He doesn't have to go looking for danger!」

DLC2311:3:t_2:21.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「I agree... But I can't bear watching him wander around like an empty shell.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:22.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Are you two all right with it? Letting $$キリコ$$'s life peter out in these lousy Battling matches?」

DLC2311:3:t_2:23.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well... You've got a point, but...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:24.en:
$$ココナ$$
「But even so... There's nothing we can do about it...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:26.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Welcome back, $$シャッコ$$. Thanks for gathering information.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:28.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I've learned there's a dangerous opponent in the battle royal $$キリコ$$ is entering tomorrow.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:30.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「If things go badly, even $$キリコ$$ could be in danger...」

DLC2311:3:t_2:31.en:
$$バニラ$$
「We knew from the start this battle royal was meant to crush $$キリコ$$, but now they've sent in an assassin?!」

DLC2311:3:t_2:32.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Just what kind of guy is he?!」

DLC2311:3:t_2:33.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Apparently, like $$キリコ$$, he's won too often and become a target for elimination.」

DLC2311:3:t_2:34.en:
$$バニラ$$
「So they threw him in hoping they'd kill each other!」

DLC2311:3:t_3:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ has invited me to join him in $$新日本$$.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:5.en:
$$桂$$
「That area's likely to see heavy fighting, too. You've got some hard battles ahead.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If battle won't leave me alone, I'll fight to put an end to it all.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$ would want that, too...）

DLC2311:3:t_3:8.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ゴウト$$ and the others are going to $$グルフェー$$. I'll escort them that far.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:9.en:
$$モーム$$
「What will you do after that, $$シャッコ$$?」

DLC2311:3:t_3:10.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I'm a mercenary. As long as someone needs me, I fight.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Sounds like someone's called on you, too, $$シャッコ$$.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:12.en:
$$桂$$
「I've earned the money I needed, so I guess it's time I left for my next destination.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:14.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah. I'm willing to sell my soul to the devil for that.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:15.en:
$$桂$$
「The devil's going a bit far. Let's call it a fox spirit instead.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:17.en:
$$桂$$
「I guess I don't have to worry about you anymore.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:18.en:
$$桂$$
「Though with you, I suppose I was sticking my nose where it wasn't needed.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:20.en:
$$桂$$
「That's all I needed to hear. Let's both give it our best.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:21.en:
$$桂$$
「We're bound to end up fighting together again sooner or later, anyway.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:26.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...The time that stood still has slowly begun moving again...」

DLC2311:3:t_3:27.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Even after losing $$フィアナ$$, my life still has meaning...」

DLC2311:3:t_3:28.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The people who worry about me... The people who try to kill me... All of it lies within battle.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:29.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll return to the battlefield and keep fighting.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:30.en:
$$キリコ$$
「For the world without war that $$フィアナ$$ dreamed of...」

DLC2311:3:t_3:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$キリコ$$ and $$桂$$... And so the two of them set off for new battlefields.」

DLC2311:3:t_3:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if those two had really gone all out against each other, I wonder who would have won...」

DLC2311:3:t_3:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure it would have been a match worth betting a fortune on...」

DLC2311:3:t_3:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2311:4:t_000:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...You don't have to join me.」

DLC2311:4:t_000:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「This battle royal is meant to crush you. You need someone to watch your back.」

DLC2311:4:t_000:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「All the more reason not to.」

DLC2311:4:t_000:3.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「...Are you trying to follow $$フィアナ$$ into death?」

DLC2311:4:t_000:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I'll hear you out properly later. They're coming.」

DLC2311:4:t_001:1.en:
$$バニラ$$
「I know they want to crush $$キリコ$$, but this is way too many!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Even with $$シャッコ$$ backing him up, this is bad!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:3.en:
Spectator
「Serves you right, $$レッドショルダー$$! You worked a little too hard!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:4.en:
Spectator
「Today's the day we finally get to see you lose!」

review.context: After Fyana's death, Chirico numbly earns money in rigged Battling matches. His friends worry while a battle royal intended to eliminate him introduces Kei.
decisions: Chirico's response to following Fyana retains his bleak conditional reference to his inability to die.
Kei's fox spirit reference is left as the source's teasing indirect description rather than inserting an absent name.
